mainEntity.name: Can Stellar manage older lakefront high-rises in Edgewater?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — vintage high-rise management is one of our core strengths. Edgewater's lakefront towers need proactive masonry and facade programs, riser and window replacement planning, and reserves that anticipate lakefront weathering. We build board-approved capital calendars for each building.

mainEntity.name: Does Stellar Property Management serve Edgewater?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Stellar Property Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Edgewater, Chicago (ZIP 60660, 60640), backed by a Chicago office that has served area communities since 2007 — 29 associations and approximately 1,422 residences under management, with a 96% client retention rate since 2007.

mainEntity.name: What types of community associations does Stellar manage in Edgewater?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar's association-management model is designed for condominiums, high-rises, HOAs in Edgewater. Every client community receives a dedicated property manager, transparent monthly financial reporting, 24/7 live emergency response, and board support informed by applicable Illinois association requirements.

mainEntity.name: How much does association management cost in Edgewater?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar management starts at $20 per unit per month. We quote a customized flat monthly fee based on your Edgewater association's size, amenities, staffing, financial complexity, and service scope — never a percentage of your budget. We do not add a separate capital-project planning or management-oversight fee. Third-party professional and contractor costs remain association expenses.

mainEntity.name: How do we switch our Edgewater association to Stellar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Switching is a managed 30–60 day transition: once your board signs, we retrieve records from the outgoing firm, migrate banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open your board and resident portals. Call 773.728.0652 or request a proposal online to start.

mainEntity.name: How should a Edgewater board choose a condo or HOA management company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compare at least three firms on the same terms: an active Illinois management firm license, a credentialed manager (CMCA, AMS or PCAM), a flat monthly fee in writing, who answers emergencies at night, and how records move during the transition. Stellar Property Management is a licensed Chicago firm (license #291000211) that has managed associations since 2007, publishes its pricing, and answers emergencies with a live person 24/7. Boards in Edgewater can score any proposals side by side with Stellar's free comparison tool at stellarpropertygroup.com/tools/compare-management-proposals.
